title: BreenGL graphics library
summary: BreenGL draws shapes, text, images and widgets exactly to its written contract and rejects malformed fonts and images within bounded work, and windows created, committed, composed, observed on the display and destroyed through the kernel's window interface behave the same, safely, on every target.
